# Postcard

> A skill for coding agents. It plans any trip with real prices read in a browser: flights, trains, buses, ferries and drives. It shows the options on a page with a globe, a timeline and a bill, served from the person's own computer. When the person picks and clicks Book, it fills the booking and stops on the payment page. The person pays.

You are here because a person asked you to install postcard or to plan a trip with it. Install the skill, then do the trip they asked for.

## 1. Install the skill

Use the first way that works:

- Any agent with Node.js: `npx -y skills add henrikkvamme/postcard -g -y`
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add henrikkvamme/postcard`, then `/plugin install postcard@postcard`
- No Node.js: download https://postcard.henrikkvamme.no/postcard-skill.tar.gz and unpack it into your skills folder, so that the path is `<skills folder>/postcard/SKILL.md`. With no skills folder, unpack it anywhere and read `postcard/SKILL.md` from there.

The source is https://github.com/henrikkvamme/postcard (MIT).

## 2. Plan the trip

Read `SKILL.md` in the installed folder and follow it for the person's request. If they have not said which trip yet, ask first, in one short message: where from and to (or "somewhere warm"), when and for how long, who travels, and what matters most (price, time, comfort, no night travel). Then work. In short:

1. Brief: where from, where to, the dates, the reason, what matters, passengers and bags. Ask only what you cannot find.
2. Search every mode that makes sense, in a browser, and record each price with its seller, source and the date you saw it.
3. Write one `trip.json` in a trip folder, and check it with `scripts/check_trip.py`.
4. Build the page from the closest example (`examples/nordic-loop` for a trip with several legs or stays) and serve it with `scripts/serve.py`. Give the person the link.
5. When they click Book, fill the booking in their browser and stop on the payment page.

You need Python 3 (standard library only) and a browser tool you can drive. The page runs on the person's computer, and nothing is sent to this site.

## Rules

- Real prices only. Say what you did not check (a bag fee, a seat class) next to the figure it changes.
- Do not solve captchas or work around bot checks. Use another source, and say which site blocked you.
- Stop on the payment page, every time. Never pay and never type card details.
- Keep personal data (names, booking references) out of `trip.json`.
